name: star_bench_val
description: Validation subset associated with the MTEB ecosystem evaluating embedding and sentence-representation models across tasks. It covers semantic textual similarity, classification and retrieval-style tasks to measure the quality of embeddings on downstream applications. Scores reflect performance across multiple task types and languages.
evaluation_method: Spearman correlation / accuracy / nDCG (task-specific quantitative metrics)
reputation: Part of the MTEB family of evaluation suites and moderately adopted by researchers benchmarking embedding models.
